sudo -n sh -c '
printf "%s\n" "=== effective-ifconfig ==="
ifconfig
printf "%s\n" "=== effective-routes ==="
netstat -rn
printf "%s\n" "=== opnsense-interface-view ==="
configctl interface list 2>&1
printf "%s\n" "=== active-pf-rules ==="
pfctl -sr 2>&1
printf "%s\n" "=== active-pf-nat ==="
pfctl -sn 2>&1
printf "%s\n" "=== saved-zone-and-portforward-fields ==="
python3 -c "import xml.etree.ElementTree as E
r=E.parse(\"/conf/config.xml\").getroot()
i=r.find(\"interfaces\")
print(\"interfaces:\")
for x in list(i) if i is not None else []:
 print(x.tag, \"if=\",x.findtext(\"if\"),\"ipaddr=\",x.findtext(\"ipaddr\"),\"subnet=\",x.findtext(\"subnet\"),\"gateway=\",x.findtext(\"gateway\"))
n=r.find(\"nat\")
print(\"nat:\")
for x in list(n) if n is not None else []:
 if x.tag==\"rule\":
  print(\"rule\",\"interface=\",x.findtext(\"interface\"),\"protocol=\",x.findtext(\"protocol\"),\"target=\",x.findtext(\"target\"),\"local-port=\",x.findtext(\"local-port\"),\"descr=\",x.findtext(\"descr\"))
" 2>&1
'
